regions.full_page: Rol Flynn - 5 - totally deaf since 2 yrs. Had spinal maningitis. Father promised to have Masses said if boy were spared. Child recovered perfectly. Then father took to drink & refused to keep promise saying boy would have been all right even had he never promised .... Enrolled again Today.
